name: boat-shot-by-rider
comment: WP-4.8 review. The pool of entity/boat-broken-by-rider: the player (id 0, bow in slot 0 and arrows in slot 1, looking straight down) gets into the boat (id 1) with the interact op at t = 5, then shoots the boat it rides with the bow at t = 8 and t = 12 (use_item on the water below: no onItemUse, so sendUseItem, ItemBow.onItemRightClick). Each arrow hits the boat (the shooter is skipped while ticksInAir < 5) with attackEntityFrom(this.owner, 4) (EntityArrow.java:163): 40 boat damage, so the second passes 40 and EntityBoat.attackEntityFrom puts the rider off with riddenByEntity.mountEntity(this) (on top of the boat, Entity.java:992-995) before the drops and setEntityDead (EntityBoat.java:69-84). The port's arrow passes a copy of its shooter while the rider is in its slot: the boat must dismount it there. entity_state of the player and the boat and rng_state every tick.
